sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach have been the division's standout performers this season and will be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have won just once all campaign and are on a five-game losing streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, with both sides looking to keep pace with the title race after recent mixed form. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19 points) host Eccleshall (5th, 18 points) in an intriguing mid-table encounter, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) are away at Wednesfield Community (9th, 13 points). Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) face Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) at home. Lower down the table, Barnton (7th) visit Shawbury United (15th), who are in serious form trouble with six consecutive defeats. New Mills (8th, 14 points) host Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points), while Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) are at home to Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) — a crucial fixture for both sides seeking wins. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) travel to face Telford Town (18th, 6 points) in a basement-battle clash. Crewe (16th, 9 points) host Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points) on Saturday. Midweek, Brereton Social visit Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
